description: ERECTION OF A PAART SINGLE-STOREY, TWO-STOREY REAR EXTENSION AND LOFT EXTENSION
decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.

<p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">Green roofs: Green roof works shall be
carried out in accordance with the approved details as shown in 0359-HLA-DR-1200 rev 00; 03590HLA-DR-1300 rev 00. Green roof planting which dies within
a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, is removed or
becomes seriously damaged or diseased or dying, shall be replaced in the next
planting season with other planting of same approved specification, unless the
Local Planning Authority gives written consent to any variation.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">



</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">Reason: to protect and enhance the
biodiversity of the development in the interest of nature conservation and to
comply with the following development policies for Merton: policy G5 of the
London Plan 2021 and policies O15.1, 015.2, O15.3 and O15.5 of the Local Plan
2024.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="line-height: 107%;" arial",sans-serif"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Fire Strategy</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall be carried out in
accordance with the provisions of the Fire Strategy Statement prepared by&nbsp;</span>Harper Latter Architects<span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;and must fully comply with The Building Regulation
2010 (as amended) unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure that the development incorporates the
necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan
Policy D12.</span></p>

No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:-1.0pt;margin-bottom:
8.0pt;margin-left:-1.0pt"><span lang="EN-US">Flood Risk - The flood mitigation measures shall be implemented prior
to the first occupation of the development hereby approved in accordance with
submitted approved plans and householder flood risk form, and shall be retained
thereafter for the provision of flood proofing measures and surface water
drainage.&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:-1.0pt;margin-bottom:
8.0pt;margin-left:-1.0pt"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span><span lang="EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">Reason: To ensure satisfactory means of surface water drainage, to
reduce the risk of flooding and to comply with the following Development Plan
policies for Merton: policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021, </span><span lang="EN-US">policies</span> F15.7, F15.8 of the Merton Local Plan 2024<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

External Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
